name: zeffect_handle_conditional_chain_event
description: zEffect::HandleConditionalChainEvent evaluates conditional animation chain markers, advances through failed if/else-if groups, and stops at the matching branch or end marker.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this conditional-event dispatcher; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect animation event source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45c3c0 validates condition mask priority for random, reference-distance, reference-position raycast, node raycast, and effect-level conditions; random table index wrap modulo 200; cached reference-distance reuse for repeated masks; TraceUpwardHitFromNodeOrPos calls for masks 0x08 and 0x10; failed-condition scan by event byteSize to marker types 0x20/0x21/0x22; else-if threshold/mask reload; stop-on-match behavior; and return value 2 with one stack argument cleaned.
The native zEffect smoke verifies immediate effect-level match, failed if to random else-if progression with rand-index advance, and fall-through to the end marker when no branch matches.
